test_title: PYST 7: SSC CGL - Reasoning (Held On : 13 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b15a24e699ea0fbabf45d419712361e95e5ee593dbdb56c347680551be615f41.png]
solution:
The figure pattern followed to replace ? is as shown below :

 
• Alphabets are added +3 from figure to figure so, In fourth figure the alphabet should be "J". → Option 2 and 4 are eliminated.
 
• The heart symbol with a line is rotated 45⁰ clockwise direction → Option 1 eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3807c525e7b46f5dd10241e0ef011b675dd1548ce40ab064e22f5a6b80c8ef1a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
